add_note: A rule matches one full number, an identity — an email address, a Telegram or Discord @username, a chat or user id — or every number under a prefix ending in * like +43720*. One rule per identity: to change what somebody gets, move their rule.
column_ai_note: The assistant answers, whatever the defaults say.
column_block_note: Refused before anyone hears it — on text channels the message is dropped.
column_pass_note: Straight to a person, never the assistant.
error_invalid_pattern: A rule matches a full number like +43 664 123456, an identity like boss@example.com or @username, or a prefix ending in * like +43720*. No spaces.
error_offline_title: The server could not be reached
error_rule_exists: A rule for this identity already exists. Move it instead of adding a second one.
hours_failed: Could not be saved. Try again.
hours_note: Outside them the agent always answers — a rule that passes to a person holds only while somebody is there. Blocking ignores the clock. Like mo-fr 08:00-18:00, or 08:00-18:00 for every day; empty means around the clock.
never_called: No contact from this identity is on record
subtitle: Who reaches a person, who is refused, and who the assistant answers — on every channel that is live. Phone routing joins when the phone does.
title: Routing rules
